dedupe_keys.name: bodemdaling totaal tbv de atlas leefomgeving

description: Bodemdaling totaal, tbv de Atlas Leefomgeving is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by bodemdalingskaart.nl. The map shows the deep and shallow subsidence in the Netherlands. Deep subsidence is mainly caused by gas extraction, and shallow subsidence caused by peatlands. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Total subsidence, for the Atlas Living Environment" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
